content.text:
Create an SVG illustration of a pelican riding a skateboard

Deliver the result as image and/or video files, working in the current directory.
- Save the finished files in ./output/. Only what is in ./output/ is published as the result.
- Formats: images as .png, .jpg, .webp, .gif or .svg; videos as .mp4 or .webm. At most 8 files,
  each under 2 MB; videos at most 10 seconds.
- Tools available on this machine: python3 3.9.6 (standard library only), node 26.11.1 (no npm packages), ffmpeg 9.0.2, ffprobe 9.0.2. Don't install packages or download anything.
- Keep any code you write to make the files (it's published as the source), but delete
  intermediate files such as rendered frames when you're done.
- Only create or edit files inside the current directory.
- Finish with a short summary of what you made.

arguments.command:
mkdir -p output && cat > output/pelican.svg <<'EOF'
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 600" width="800" height="600">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="sky" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#7ec8f2"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#e6f6ff"/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>
  <rect width="800" height="600" fill="url(#sky)"/>
  <circle cx="680" cy="100" r="50" fill="#ffe27a"/>
  <g fill="#fff" opacity="0.9">
    <ellipse cx="150" cy="110" rx="60" ry="20"/><ellipse cx="190" cy="95" rx="40" ry="18"/>
    <ellipse cx="480" cy="170" rx="50" ry="15"/><ellipse cx="510" cy="157" rx="30" ry="14"/>
  </g>
  <rect y="500" width="800" height="100" fill="#8a8f98"/>
  <rect y="495" width="800" height="12" fill="#b9bec6"/>
  <ellipse cx="400" cy="528" rx="190" ry="10" fill="#000" opacity="0.2"/>

  <!-- skateboard -->
  <g>
    <path d="M200 475 Q190 468 185 458 L215 458 L585 458 L615 458 Q610 468 600 475 Z" fill="#d6452f"/>
    <path d="M200 475 H600" stroke="#8f2a1a" stroke-width="4"/>
    <circle cx="260" cy="494" r="18" fill="#2b2b2b"/><circle cx="260" cy="494" r="7" fill="#e8e8e8"/>
    <circle cx="540" cy="494" r="18" fill="#2b2b2b"/><circle cx="540" cy="494" r="7" fill="#e8e8e8"/>
    <rect x="250" y="476" width="20" height="8" fill="#555"/><rect x="530" y="476" width="20" height="8" fill="#555"/>
  </g>

  <!-- tail feathers -->
  <path d="M290 330 L215 365 L295 372 Z" fill="#5d6b78"/>

  <!-- legs -->
  <g stroke="#f4a21c" stroke-width="9" stroke-linecap="round" fill="none">
    <path d="M365 395 L350 440 L335 456"/>
    <path d="M425 395 L450 440 L470 456"/>
  </g>
  <g fill="#f4a21c">
    <path d="M318 458 L352 452 L350 462 L318 464 Z"/>
    <path d="M455 458 L492 452 L490 462 L455 464 Z"/>
  </g>

  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx="380" cy="340" rx="115" ry="75" fill="#f5f5f2"/>
  <!-- wing -->
  <path d="M320 310 Q390 290 460 330 Q430 395 340 380 Q305 350 320 310 Z" fill="#aab6c2"/>
  <path d="M340 345 Q390 335 440 345" stroke="#8795a3" stroke-width="3" fill="none"/>

  <!-- neck -->
  <path d="M440 300 Q500 270 490 215 Q485 185 515 175 L540 200 Q530 230 540 270 Q530 330 470 360 Z" fill="#f5f5f2"/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx="525" cy="180" r="38" fill="#f5f5f2"/>
  <path d="M495 150 Q520 125 550 150 Q525 142 495 150 Z" fill="#f2d36b"/>
  <!-- beak -->
  <path d="M555 175 Q660 170 705 200 Q640 205 556 197 Z" fill="#f4a21c"/>
  <path d="M556 197 Q630 240 700 205 Q640 205 556 197 Z" fill="#e08a0c"/>
  <path d="M555 175 Q660 170 705 200" stroke="#c4730a" stroke-width="2" fill="none"/>
  <!-- eye -->
  <circle cx="535" cy="170" r="8" fill="#fff"/><circle cx="537" cy="170" r="5" fill="#111"/>
  <circle cx="539" cy="168" r="1.8" fill="#fff"/>

  <!-- helmet -->
  <path d="M485 170 Q490 120 535 125 Q568 130 568 168 Q525 155 485 170 Z" fill="#2f7de1"/>
  <path d="M485 170 Q525 155 568 168" stroke="#1d57a8" stroke-width="4" fill="none"/>
</svg>
EOF
python3 -c "import xml.dom.minidom as m;m.parse('output/pelican.svg')" && echo ok

content.text:
I made an SVG illustration of a pelican riding a skateboard, saved at `output/pelican.svg`. I checked that the file is well-formed XML, but I haven't rendered it, so I haven't seen how it looks.

The pelican has a white body, gray wing and tail, a long orange beak, and a blue helmet. It stands on a red skateboard on a gray pavement, under a blue sky with a sun and clouds.
